description: Source code for get_helper.c, providing functions for handling commands, managing lists, and error reporting in the bbfdm-ubus module.

methods.name: bbfdm_cmd_exec
methods.description: Executes a command within the bbfdm context, handling faults and logging warnings.

methods.name: bb_add_string
methods.description: Adds a string parameter to a blob buffer.

methods.name: bbf_sub_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up a sub-context for bbfdm.

methods.name: match_with_path_list
methods.description: Checks if an entry matches any path in the list.

methods.name: present_in_path_list
methods.description: Checks if an entry is present in the path list.

methods.name: present_in_pv_list
methods.description: Checks if a parameter is present in the parameter-value list.

methods.name: add_pv_list
methods.description: Adds a parameter-value pair to the list.

methods.name: free_pv_list
methods.description: Frees all entries in the parameter-value list.

methods.name: add_path_list
methods.description: Adds a path to the path list.

methods.name: free_path_list
methods.description: Frees all entries in the path list.

methods.name: fill_err_code_table
methods.description: Fills error code information into a table in the blob buffer.

methods.name: fill_err_code_array
methods.description: Fills error code information into an array in the blob buffer.
